scenario_context: Wrong/damaged item delivered. Replacement is default; refund occurs after return pickup/return initiated within 7 days. Request photos politely if required. Offer expedited pickup/replacement and clear timelines.

customer_profile.opening_message: Wrong item and damaged box. I want a refund today.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent initiates pickup immediately and gives clear refund timeline

checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Start with empathy; don’t jump to policy.

checkpoints.description: Verify order details (order ID, delivery date, expected vs received)
Request photos politely if required; avoid accusatory tone
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Ask for photos as a process step, not suspicion.

checkpoints.description: Offer options: expedited replacement OR return pickup + refund after initiated
Initiate pickup/label and provide refund timeline + next update time

success_summary: Delivery issue handled with empathy, action (pickup/replacement), and clear refund timelines.
